provenance_note: All client/vendor/human/address data excluded. Multifamily residential vertical retained; copy structure only.

classification.illumination_scope: core cabinet only; wings and stone base unlit

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A double-sided community monument: a routed-and-backed illuminated aluminum ID cabinet flanked by composite-clad accent wings, set on a dry-stacked stone base, with brushed flat-cut address numerals. Logo and copy are routed from the faces and backed with translucent white polycarbonate for an even night glow.
knowledge.rationale: Routed-and-backed faces give a cheaper even halo of light through the copy than push-thru; the stone base, Trex wood-look wings and brushed-aluminum address build curb appeal for a residential audience.

structure.construction: fabricated aluminum frame + .090in skin + 0.125in faces, logo/copy routed and backed with translucent white polycarbonate, internal white LEDs, painted P1
fabricated aluminum core + top cap painted P2, sheathed with 1x3in Trex Transcend Havana Gold composite cladding
EPS foam block core with dry-stacked stone veneer, field-installed
flat-cut 1/4in aluminum, horizontal brushed grain, flush-mounted to base

materials_manifest.product: Trex Transcend Havana Gold composite board
dry-stacked stone veneer over EPS foam core

craft_observations: Strong residential material mix: matte coal-blue cabinet, brushed-aluminum address, Trex wood-look wings, real stone base.
Routed-and-backed faces are a simpler, cheaper lit-copy method than push-thru.

aesthetic_notes.note: Reads as a built landscape element, warmer than a bare cabinet on a pole.
